Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 1. Remark 3.6\group variation-formulas

Writing $(\delta h)_k=-g^{ij} abla _i h_{jk}$, and denoting by $\Delta _L$ the Lichnerowicz Laplacian, the variation of $\Rc $ can be rewritten in terms of $\Delta _L h$, $ abla abla H$, and $\delta h$, where $H= r _g h$.
